label: RFID Attendance
info:
Smart RFID Student Attendance & Parent Notification System.
Ingress: MQTT (school/attendance/scan) or HTTP POST /attendance.
Egress : CSV log, Telegram to parent, ACK back to the ESP32 LCD.

name: 1 - Student database
info:
Put students.json next to your Node-RED settings.js (the userDir, usually
~/.node-red or %USERPROFILE%\.node-red).

It loads automatically 0.5 s after deploy. After editing the file, click the
inject button to reload it - no restart needed.

name: 2 - Scan ingress (MQTT or HTTP)
info:
The ESP32 publishes {"device":"gate-01","uid":"A1B2C3D4","timestamp":"..."}
to school/attendance/scan.

The HTTP node is the fallback: POST the same JSON to
http://<node-red-host>:1880/attendance

name: Normalise + dedupe
Match student
3 - Known student: log + notify
info:
Create attendance/attendance.csv ONCE with this header line:
Date,Time,StudentID,Name,Class,UID,Device

Paths are relative to the Node-RED userDir. Open the .csv directly in Excel,
or swap the file node for node-red-contrib-excel-port to write .xlsx.

name: Build CSV row
Build Telegram message
Build Sheets row (optional)
4 - Answer the reader
info:
Every tap gets a reply so the LCD can show a verdict.
MQTT scans are answered on school/attendance/ack.
HTTP scans are answered in the HTTP response.

name: Build LCD ACK
5 - Unknown cards & errors
info:
Unregistered UIDs land in attendance/unknown_uids.csv.
Header: Date,Time,UID,Device
Copy a UID from there into students.json to enrol a new student.

name: Log unknown UID
6 - Bench test (no hardware needed)
info:
Click this inject to push a fake scan through the whole flow.
Edit the uid to test the known / unknown / duplicate paths.
